claim: Demo changes stay in a separate memory-only workspace and never touch a real queue.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a sentinel real device key; enter demo, inspect seeded states and RSS, mutate, reset, exit, and prove the demo workspace is destroyed without changing the real key

claim: The queue stores entered link metadata, priority, and state without fetching link contents or importing public feeds.
where: landing facts, save form, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo tenant; save an unreachable URL, change priority and state, assert every stored field, assert no request reaches it, and assert the removed import route is 404

claim: Export CSV writes one row for every saved link.
sandbox: fresh /demo tenant; download CSV and assert its header, three data rows, state, priority, and sample title

claim: Create a private RSS link for queued links and revoke it later.
where: How it works, RSS panel, README
sandbox: fresh /demo tenant; create link, fetch RSS, assert two queued items, valid dates and no-store caching, revoke, then assert the same URL returns 404

claim: Each device key opens only its own queue, and the server stores only a one-way hash of that key.
sandbox: create two fresh real sessions; save through the first; assert the second cannot list or update the item and raw device keys are absent while their hashes are present in SQLite

claim: The app uses no analytics, ads, external fonts, or third-party scripts.
where: landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo tenant; capture the full load, RSS-create, and CSV-export request log; assert every request is same-origin

claim: The included browser extension downloads from this site and saves the active tab title, link, and entered tags.
sandbox: open the live setup page and package, then run the shipped popup and settings pages with recorded browser/API fixtures; assert active-tab prefill, title/link/tags payload, bearer key, exact-origin permission, and saved settings

claim: The queue is free to use and requires no account or payment.
sandbox: fresh /demo tenant; complete save, RSS creation, and CSV download; assert no login, checkout, billing, or payment request occurs

claim: An internet connection is required to save changes.
sandbox: fresh /demo page loaded while online; set the browser offline; attempt a save and assert it is not sent and gives reconnect guidance

claim: Import CSV restores exported links and skips duplicates.
sandbox: fresh /demo tenant; upload an exported-column CSV, preview it, confirm import, assert state and priority, then re-import and assert duplicate handling
